blocks.content: You already built the HTML structure. Now it's time to make it look like the Figma design.
Here's the rule for this lesson. We only style what you can actually see in Figma.
Just clean, simple CSS that matches the static desktop design.
Next you will add spacing, align the date and content columns, and style the tags so the section feels consistent and readable.
